The '''Light Hydraulic Protocol Arm''' was a lightweight [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] arm manufactured by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]]. It was notably used on the [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series]].
